name: Mix3d Streamer
summary:
The MIX3D.Streamer lets you enjoy all the features you love in a dedicated program. Launch MIX3D Streamer instantly from your desktop and start creating 3-dimensional, virtual, and mixed-reality content.
MIX3D Streamer is a no-code solution that lets you create 3D-VR & MR content for the below use cases:
Training simulations
Walkthroughs
Assessments
Case Studies
Pitch Decks
Resumes
Storyboards
Job Descriptions
Brochures
Book Experiences
Team Personas
Life Journeys
Movie Experiences
Travel logs
